source_scope: Official ATLUS Persona 3 Reload character roster on the Japanese title page, limited to its twelve named S.E.E.S. and Strega character profile entries (Yukari Takeba, Junpei Iori, Akihiko Sanada, Mitsuru Kirijo, Fuuka Yamagishi, Koromaru, Aigis, Ken Amada, Shinjiro Aragaki, Takaya, Jin, Chidori). The generic unnamed protagonist listing is excluded. No other Persona works or cast members are included.
source_claim: Official Atlus Persona 3 Reload title page names the twelve listed character profiles under S.E.E.S. and Strega.
provenance: First-party Japanese Atlus Persona 3 Reload site reviewed 2026-09-30; the page identifies the title as Persona 3 Reload and says the original Persona 3 experience is preserved, with a full remake description on its official Nintendo Switch 2 page. Exact official names were taken from profile NAME headings.
notes: Maps only exact listed character names; HOME root normalization to persona_3 follows Persona 3 original-work semantics, not the Reload qualifier.
